relationships.subject: Lu AF27139
relationships.evidence_quote: Lu AF27139 is a highly selective and potent small molecule antagonist at rat, mouse and human forms of the P2X7 receptor

relationships.subject: Lu AF27139
relationships.evidence_quote: it diminished neuropathic hypersensitivity in SNI rats, and less potently in CCI rats.

relationships.subject: Lu AF27139
relationships.evidence_quote: Lu AF27139-mediated regulation of spinal PGE2 and miRNA (e.g. rno-miR-93-5p) levels increased by CCI aligned with its ability to diminish neuropathic hypersensitivity.

key_findings: P2X7 antagonist Lu AF27139 reversed neuropathic hypersensitivity, and reduced spinal PGE2 and miRNA levels raised by CCI, suggesting biomarkers
